schemes.title: Mizoram Public Service Commission Recruitment
schemes.brief: The Mizoram Public Service Commission recruits for the state civil service and for the gazetted and technical posts of the state departments. Applications are filed on its own online portal, one profile serving every advertisement.
schemes.benefit: One online profile for every Mizoram PSC advertisement
eligibility: Indian citizen who is ordinarily a resident of Mizoram for the posts that require it
Age as the advertisement states, usually 21 to 35, with relaxation for reserved categories and disability
The qualification the advertisement requires, complete on its closing date
Knowledge of Mizo as some advertisements specify
documents: Aadhaar card
HSLC (Class 10) certificate for date of birth
Degree certificate and marksheets
Scheduled Tribe certificate of Mizoram, where claiming that reservation
Residential certificate issued by the district administration
Employment exchange registration, where the advertisement asks for it
Recent passport photograph and a scanned signature

demoFields.label: Advertisement and post applied for
demoFields.value: Mizoram Civil Service Combined Competitive Examination
demoFields.hint: One application per advertisement. Read the qualification and the age limit there before paying.

demoFields.label: Candidate Name (as on HSLC certificate)
demoFields.hint: The HSLC certificate governs, not Aadhaar, where the two differ.

demoFields.label: Father's Name
demoFields.hint: As on the HSLC certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on the HSLC certificate. Age limits count from this date.

demoFields.label: Category claimed
demoFields.hint: Claim only what you hold a Mizoram certificate for.

demoFields.label: Residential certificate number
demoFields.hint: Issued by the district administration. Required for most Mizoram state posts.

demoFields.label: Educational Qualification
demoFields.hint: It must be complete on the advertisement's closing date.

demoFields.label: Examination centre
demoFields.hint: Give a choice where the advertisement asks for one.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: The application number, admit card and every notice come here.

demoSteps: Get the residential certificate and, for a reserved category, the Mizoram Scheduled Tribe certificate before the closing date.
Register on mpsconline.mizoram.gov.in with your name and date of birth exactly as on the HSLC certificate.
Open the advertisement, apply through the same login, upload the photograph and signature in the sizes stated, and pay the fee.
Print the filled application and keep it with the payment receipt until the recruitment ends.
Download the admit card from the same login and take it with a photo ID.
Results are published on the Commission's site. Document verification is last, where the originals of everything claimed must be produced.

schemes.title: Mizoram Ration Card
schemes.department: Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs Department, Mizoram
schemes.brief: The NFSA ration card in Mizoram, in two kinds — Antyodaya for the poorest households and Priority Household for the rest. Applications are made on paper at the district Food and Civil Supplies office, with the Village Council's recommendation, which in Mizoram carries real weight.
schemes.benefit: 5 kg foodgrain per person per month; 35 kg per family for an Antyodaya card
eligibility: Family resident in Mizoram and holding no ration card elsewhere in India
Household inside the state's NFSA list and not excluded by income, land or government service
The Village Council or the Local Council must certify that the family lives in its area
Every member's Aadhaar must be given; a name without Aadhaar draws no ration
documents: Aadhaar cards of every member of the family
Village Council or Local Council certificate of residence
Deletion certificate from the earlier card, where the family or a member has moved
Birth certificate for a newborn, or marriage certificate for a bride
Income declaration of the household
Passport photograph of the head of the family
schemes.submitAt: District Food and Civil Supplies office; the Village Council or Local Council President forwards the application with its certificate

demoFields.label: Type of application
demoFields.hint: New card, add a member, remove a member, or correct a detail. Each needs a different set of papers.

demoFields.label: Head of the Household
demoFields.hint: The card is issued in this person's name and the family's entitlement is tracked against it.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar of the Head
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits.

demoFields.label: Members of the family (name, relation, age, Aadhaar)
demoFields.value: 1. Lalrinsangi Chhangte, self, 28, 9999 1187 4402; 2. Lalthanzuala Chhangte, father, 58, 9999 4402 1187; 3. Zomuani Chhangte, mother, 54, 9999 7730 2216
demoFields.hint: Everyone who eats from the same kitchen, one per line. The grain is counted per name.

demoFields.label: Category applied for
demoFields.hint: Antyodaya only if the household is on that list. When unsure, ask for Priority Household.

demoFields.label: District / Village or Local Council area
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The fair price shop is allotted from this area.

demoFields.label: Village Council or Local Council certificate
demoFields.value: President, Chanmari Local Council — signed and stamped
demoFields.hint: In Mizoram this certificate is what carries the application. Get it before you go to the district office.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: The household's total for the year. It decides the category.

demoFields.label: Signature / Thumb Impression with date
demoFields.hint: Sign or put your thumb impression, and write the date yourself.

demoSteps: Get the Village Council or Local Council certificate first. In Mizoram it is the paper the whole application rests on.
Collect the form free at the district Food and Civil Supplies office and fill it in ink, listing every member of the household with their Aadhaar.
Attach the Aadhaar copies, the Council certificate, the income declaration and, where someone has moved in, the deletion certificate from the old card.
Hand it in and ask for a dated acknowledgement with its number.
The supply staff verify the household, and the category is decided at this stage.
Collect the card and check every name, age and Aadhaar before leaving, then get each member's Aadhaar seeded at the fair price shop.
schemes.helpline: 1967 — Food and Public Distribution toll free; your District Food and Civil Supplies office

schemes.title: Nagaland Public Service Commission Recruitment
schemes.brief: The Nagaland Public Service Commission recruits for the state civil service and for the gazetted and technical posts of the state departments. Candidates register once on the applicant portal and then apply to each examination from the same account.
schemes.benefit: One applicant account for every Nagaland PSC examination
eligibility: Indigenous inhabitant of Nagaland for the posts reserved for them, proved by the indigenous inhabitant certificate
Age as the advertisement states, usually 21 to 35, with relaxation for reserved categories and disability
The qualification the advertisement requires, complete on its closing date
Each advertisement sets its own conditions; read that one before paying
documents: Aadhaar card
HSLC (Class 10) certificate for date of birth
Degree certificate and marksheets
Indigenous inhabitant certificate of Nagaland
Scheduled Tribe certificate, where claiming that reservation
Employment exchange registration, where the advertisement asks for it
Recent passport photograph and a scanned signature

demoFields.label: Examination applied for
demoFields.hint: One application per advertisement. Read the qualification and the age limit there before paying.

demoFields.label: Candidate Name (as on HSLC certificate)
demoFields.hint: The HSLC certificate governs, not Aadhaar, where the two differ.

demoFields.label: Father's Name
demoFields.hint: As on the HSLC certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on the HSLC certificate. Age limits count from this date.

demoFields.label: Indigenous inhabitant certificate number
demoFields.hint: Issued by the district administration. Most Nagaland state posts are reserved for indigenous inhabitants, so this is the key paper.

demoFields.label: Tribe and category
demoFields.hint: Claim only what you hold a Nagaland certificate for.

demoFields.label: Educational Qualification
demoFields.hint: It must be complete on the advertisement's closing date.

demoFields.label: Examination centre
demoFields.hint: Give a choice where the advertisement asks for one.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number and Email
demoFields.hint: The application number, admit card and every notice come here.

demoSteps: Get the indigenous inhabitant certificate from the district administration before the closing date. Most Nagaland state posts cannot be applied for without it.
Register on the NPSC applicant portal with your name and date of birth exactly as on the HSLC certificate.
Open the advertisement, apply from the same account, upload the photograph and signature in the sizes stated, and pay the fee.
Print the filled application and keep it with the payment receipt until the recruitment ends.
Download the admit card from the same account and take it with a photo ID.
Results are published on the Commission's site. Document verification is last, where the originals of everything claimed must be produced.
